verdicts.reproduction: Wrote my OWN gold-matching solution (review/work/54/verify/v_gold.py: full-hat basis, kappa=1, Pe=200 FIXED in tau, Nitsche-only stabilization, column b/sol) -> steptest joint PASS on all 4 steps; assemble(M) matches h5 targets to max|dA|<=2.3e-12 for M=11/23/35. One-variable change to the SPEC-LITERAL Pe=|a|h/(2*kappa), kappa=1 (v_spectau.py) -> 54.2 FAIL (all 3 tests, isolate) and 54.4 FAIL, official joint mode. Decoded F=(1-b[0]/h^3)/2 = 0.995000000000 EXACTLY for all three M (h-independent) -> Pe=200 exactly. Off-diagonal A[0,1]=0.5-kappa/h=-9.5 pins kappa=1 independently, so the targets are internally inconsistent with the stated formula. Root-finding over constant kappa matching A[0,0] under the stated formula gives kappa*=6.4653 (M=11), 3.8977 (M=23), 3.0296 (M=35) -- mutually inconsistent, so NO constant kappa rescues it (stronger than the first pass's narrow-grid argument, same conclusion).
